sim_product_mapping.list: SELECT sim_product_mapping.id, sim_product_mapping.sim_id, sim_product_mapping.date_created, sim_product_mapping.date_updated, sim_product_mapping.product_id, sim_product_mapping.product_serial_number FROM sim_product_mapping ORDER BY sim_product_mapping.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sim_status.list: SELECT sim_status.id, sim_status.mobile_number, sim_status.status, sim_status.date_created FROM sim_status ORDER BY sim_status.id DESC LIMIT 100;

smd_population_wip_delivery.list: SELECT smd_population_wip_delivery.id, smd_population_wip_delivery.date_created, smd_population_wip_delivery.assembler_id, smd_population_wip_delivery.sub_assembly_type_id, smd_population_wip_delivery.population_wip_id FROM smd_population_wip_delivery ORDER BY smd_population_wip_delivery.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sms_log.list: SELECT sms_log.id, sms_log.message_content, sms_log.date_created, sms_log.date_updated, sms_log.mobile_number, sms_log.detail FROM sms_log ORDER BY sms_log.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sms_provider.list: SELECT sms_provider.id, sms_provider.base_url, sms_provider.priority, sms_provider.provider_type, sms_provider.send_api_endpoint, sms_provider.username FROM sms_provider ORDER BY sms_provider.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sms_template.list: SELECT sms_template.id, sms_template.name, sms_template.date_created, sms_template.date_updated, sms_template.is_active, sms_template.template_content FROM sms_template ORDER BY sms_template.id DESC LIMIT 100;

state.list: SELECT state.id, state.name, state.date_created, state.date_updated, state.is_active, state.display_type FROM state ORDER BY state.id DESC LIMIT 100;

state_office.list: SELECT state_office.id, state_office.name, state_office.short_code, state_office.address FROM state_office ORDER BY state_office.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly.list: SELECT sub_assembly.id, sub_assembly.sub_assembly_serial_number, sub_assembly.date_created, sub_assembly.date_updated, sub_assembly.is_active, sub_assembly.sub_assembly_type_id FROM sub_assembly ORDER BY sub_assembly.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly_product.list: SELECT sub_assembly_product.id, sub_assembly_product.date_created, sub_assembly_product.created_by, sub_assembly_product.sub_assembly_id, sub_assembly_product.product_id FROM sub_assembly_product ORDER BY sub_assembly_product.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly_state.list: SELECT sub_assembly_state.id, sub_assembly_state.comment, sub_assembly_state.date_created, sub_assembly_state.created_by, sub_assembly_state.state_id, sub_assembly_state.sub_assembly_id FROM sub_assembly_state ORDER BY sub_assembly_state.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly_state_issue.list: SELECT sub_assembly_state_issue.id, sub_assembly_state_issue.date_created, sub_assembly_state_issue.is_active, sub_assembly_state_issue.issue_tags_id, sub_assembly_state_issue.sub_assembly_state_id FROM sub_assembly_state_issue ORDER BY sub_assembly_state_issue.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly_state_priority_component.list: SELECT sub_assembly_state_priority_component.id, sub_assembly_state_priority_component.date_created, sub_assembly_state_priority_component.date_updated, sub_assembly_state_priority_component.sub_assembly_type_id, sub_assembly_state_priority_component.sub_assembly_type_state_id FROM sub_assembly_state_priority_component ORDER BY sub_assembly_state_priority_component.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly_state_product.list: SELECT sub_assembly_state_product.id, sub_assembly_state_product.date_created, sub_assembly_state_product.created_by, sub_assembly_state_product.sub_assembly_state_id, sub_assembly_state_product.product_id FROM sub_assembly_state_product ORDER BY sub_assembly_state_product.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly_type.list: SELECT sub_assembly_type.id, sub_assembly_type.sub_assembly_type, sub_assembly_type.date_created, sub_assembly_type.date_updated, sub_assembly_type.is_active, sub_assembly_type.serial_number_prefix FROM sub_assembly_type ORDER BY sub_assembly_type.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly_type_bom.list: SELECT sub_assembly_type_bom.id, sub_assembly_type_bom.date_created, sub_assembly_type_bom.date_updated, sub_assembly_type_bom.sub_assembly_type_id, sub_assembly_type_bom.component_id FROM sub_assembly_type_bom ORDER BY sub_assembly_type_bom.id DESC LIMIT 100;

sub_assembly_type_state.list: SELECT sub_assembly_type_state.id, sub_assembly_type_state.priority, sub_assembly_type_state.date_created, sub_assembly_type_state.date_updated FROM sub_assembly_type_state ORDER BY sub_assembly_type_state.id DESC LIMIT 100;

trackable_component_dc_cost.list: SELECT trackable_component_dc_cost.id, trackable_component_dc_cost.date_created, trackable_component_dc_cost.date_updated, trackable_component_dc_cost.cost, trackable_component_dc_cost.serially_trackable_component_id FROM trackable_component_dc_cost ORDER BY trackable_component_dc_cost.id DESC LIMIT 100;

unhandled_log.list: SELECT unhandled_log.id, unhandled_log.stack_trace, unhandled_log.date_created, unhandled_log.type, unhandled_log.created_by, unhandled_log.field_one FROM unhandled_log ORDER BY unhandled_log.id DESC LIMIT 100;

user.list: SELECT user.id, user.email_id, user.date_created, user.date_updated, user.is_active, user.first_name FROM user WHERE user.company_id = {company_id} ORDER BY user.id DESC LIMIT 100;

vendor.list: SELECT vendor.id, vendor.name, vendor.date_created, vendor.date_updated, vendor.phone_number, vendor.gst_number FROM vendor ORDER BY vendor.id DESC LIMIT 100;

wip_component_reduce_history.list: SELECT wip_component_reduce_history.id, wip_component_reduce_history.date_created, wip_component_reduce_history.wip_id, wip_component_reduce_history.wip_category, wip_component_reduce_history.component_id FROM wip_component_reduce_history ORDER BY wip_component_reduce_history.id DESC LIMIT 100;

wip_delivery_chalan.list: SELECT wip_delivery_chalan.id, wip_delivery_chalan.delivery_chalan_number, wip_delivery_chalan.date_created, wip_delivery_chalan.date_updated, wip_delivery_chalan.reference_number, wip_delivery_chalan.provided_by FROM wip_delivery_chalan ORDER BY wip_delivery_chalan.id DESC LIMIT 100;

wip_product_delivery.list: SELECT wip_product_delivery.id, wip_product_delivery.date_created, wip_product_delivery.wip_product_version_mapping_id, wip_product_delivery.delivered_quantity, wip_product_delivery.created_by FROM wip_product_delivery ORDER BY wip_product_delivery.id DESC LIMIT 100;

work_in_progress.list: SELECT work_in_progress.id, work_in_progress.name, work_in_progress.status, work_in_progress.order_date, work_in_progress.expected_date FROM work_in_progress ORDER BY work_in_progress.id DESC LIMIT 100;

work_in_progress_product_mapping.list: SELECT work_in_progress_product_mapping.id, work_in_progress_product_mapping.status, work_in_progress_product_mapping.date_created, work_in_progress_product_mapping.product_version_id, work_in_progress_product_mapping.wip_id FROM work_in_progress_product_mapping ORDER BY work_in_progress_product_mapping.id DESC LIMIT 100;
